title: Cameroon Tech Jobs
shortDescription: A Django 5 job board for Cameroon tech hiring with employer/job-seeker dashboards, search, applications, payments readiness, admin controls, and mobile-friendly PWA behavior.
longDescription: Cameroon Tech Jobs is a Django job board for the Cameroon tech community. Companies can post openings, job seekers can browse and apply, and both sides can manage applications, interviews, notifications, and paid listing workflows from one place.
problem: Tech professionals in Cameroon need a focused place to discover local opportunities, while employers need practical tools for publishing roles, managing applications, and communicating with candidates.
solution: Built a Cameroon-focused job board with separate company and job seeker accounts, searchable job listings, application tracking, interview scheduling, notifications, paid listing readiness, and admin analytics.
architecture: Django 5 application with PostgreSQL via Neon, Cloudinary media handling, WhiteNoise static assets, Celery and Redis for asynchronous work, Tranzak payment flow support, and Render-ready deployment scripts.
features: Company and job seeker accounts with separate dashboards
Job listing creation, management, search, and filtering
Applications with status tracking and unique per-seeker constraints
Notifications for applications, messages, and interview updates
Paid listing plans with Tranzak payment integration readiness
Admin analytics dashboard and demo data seeding
challenges: Designing role-based workflows for companies and job seekers
Modeling applications, interviews, notifications, and paid listing logic cleanly
Preparing deployment for external services such as Neon, Cloudinary, Redis, and Render
lessonsLearned: Job boards need strong search and filtering before advanced matching features
Role separation makes dashboard UX clearer and reduces permission mistakes
Deployment documentation and demo data make a product easier to evaluate quickly
futureImprovements: AI-powered resume review and job-fit scoring
More employer analytics and candidate pipeline reporting
Native mobile applications for employers and candidates
